questions.question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

In his memoir, __Attenborough said that, "Lisa would have been 11 if she was__ with us today."

options.text: Attenborough said that, "Lisa will have been 11 if she were
Attenborough said, "Lisa would have been 11 if she were
Attenborough said, "Lisa would have been 11 if she was

questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Attenborough said, "Lisa would have been 11 if she were'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The underlined part in the given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'Attenborough said, "Lisa would have been 11 if she were' **should be used instead of '**Attenborough said that, "Lisa would have been 11 if she was'.**
 
• The reported speech in the given sentence is an example of **second** conditional.
 
• The structure of these kinds of sentence is: 
 
 
• *If I were you + I would/wouldn't + V1 + Object.*
 
 
 
• For Examples:-
 
 
• If I were you, I would study more.
 
• If I were you, I would stop doing that.
 
 
 
• Generally, we use **'had + V₃' **in these kinds of conditions. But here, no such option is given.
 
• Hence, the most appropriate answer is Option 2.**
 

Correct Sentence:__** *In his memoir, **Attenborough said, "Lisa would have been 11 if she were** with us today."*

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

If I ______ a doctor, I would have treated you all.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**were**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**were**'.

 
• "If I were you" is used when we give advice by imagining ourselves in the position of the other person.
 
• The structure of such sentences is as follows:-
 
 
• **If I were a doctor + I would/wouldn't + V1 + Object.**
 
 
 
• If I were you ... is used when giving advice about what you would do in the same situation as the other person.
 
• You **imagine** yourself in their position or situation and what you would do or how you would react.
 
• For Examples:-
 
 
• If I were you, I would study more.
 
• If I were you, I would stop doing that.
 
• If I were you, I would go to the doctor.
 
• If I were you, I wouldn't play with those wires.
 
 
 
• We can also change the order of the sentence.
 
• For Examples:-
 
 
• I would study more if I were you.
 
• I would be more careful if I were you.
 
• I wouldn't do that if I were you.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 1.

 

Correct Sentence:__* **If I **were** a doctor, I would have treated you all.*

My company __beliefs__ that no one should turn up late for work.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**believes**'.

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, '**believes**' should be used instead of '**beliefs**'.
 
• We know that '**believe**' (with a v) is** a verb**. It means to have confidence in the truth.
 
• Then, '**belief**' (with an f) is a noun. It means a religious faith or the feeling of being certain that something is true. 
 
• *Example: *
 
 
• *You shouldn't **believe** everything you read.*
 
• *There is a growing **belief** that these policies will not succeed.*
 
 
 
• In the given context we need a verb that is '**believes**' not a noun '**belief**'.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 2.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *My company **believes** that no one should turn up late for work.*

**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

Human being are / the producers and the / consumers of Earth’s / resources.
questions.solution:
The erroneous part is '**Human being are**'.

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The error lies in** part 1** of the given sentence.
 
• Here, **'Human beings are'** should be used instead of **'Human being are'.**
 
• ** We** can deduce that the nouns used in the above given sentence are in plural form (producers and consumers)
 
• There is also the usage of parallelism in the above given sentence to maintain the homogeneity throughout.
 
• As per the rules of subject verb agreement, plural subject takes a plural verb with it and singular subject with a singular verb.
 
• ** Here 'Human being'** refers to a **singular **person. Hence, it should be changed into** 'Human beings'.**
 
• ** Human beings **refers to a **plural subject and **as per the** subject verb agreement and parallelism concept, 'human beings' fit well in the given context.**
 
• **'Human being' **means 'a man, woman, or child of the species Homo sapiens, distinguished from other animals by superior mental development, power of articulate speech, and upright stance.'
 
 
• ***Example:** The drug has not yet been tested on **human beings.***
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

**Correct Answer:__** ***Human beings are** the producers and the consumers of Earth's resources.*
